supersedes_only: The earlier no-elevation restriction, for this single explicitly authorized round only. All historical contracts remain unchanged.
authorization: PM permits one explicit sdb root on round for read-only product profiling. Record id before (UID 5001), after (UID 0), and after mandatory root off (UID 5001). No automatic elevation in existing runners. A failed root off is recorded; no automatic retry.
identity: Check product kernel, armv7l and Tizen TV image before elevation; repeat after elevation. Never identify by endpoint alone.
scope: Read proc smaps/status/stat, full ps, meminfo/zram, identity/environment and rpm queries. Only the sampling script may be written under /tmp; stdout streams to host; verify and remove that script immediately after exit.
candidates: Rediscover exact historical names plus top ten readable userspace heap PD. Require PID 1 in root ps and proc view; retain all exclusions and disclose accessible-ranking limitations. No silently substituted near matches.
sampling_and_analysis: Unchanged portable contract: 601 points / 600 seconds, 1-second deadlines, same PD buckets, faults, global fields and frozen analyze_floor.py/historical classifier; no stimulus, no retries or zero-filling.
cleanup: Any failed gate stops observations. Mandatory own-script cleanup (only when ownership and termination are proven), then root off and id verification even on failure. Report any cleanup or privilege-restoration failure, never call kill.
publication: Append report, public sanitized compact evidence, main only. PM authorization date and actual execution time are both recorded. Root authorization is not reusable by future rounds.
